purpose: Human semantic challenge set only. Canonical-HP-exact numeric HP-stat cases are excluded and validated separately against structured Pokemon TCG API metadata.

prior_holdout_exclusion.rule: No evidence_id or normalized title from V1 or V2R is eligible.

structural_hp_exclusion.rule: Exclude a title when an adjacent numeric HP value exactly equals pokemon_canonical_cards.source_payload.hp using fraction-safe boundaries.
structural_hp_exclusion.reason: These are machine-verifiable printed HP stat cases, not semantic condition-label cases.

sampling.method: Deterministic md5 ordering after normalized-title dedupe, prior-holdout exclusion, and structural HP-stat exclusion.
sampling.quota: 4 rows per sampling-stratum x price-band cell; 7 strata x 4 bands = 112 rows.

fingerprint_method: md5(comma-joined evidence_id values in review_index order)
